compiled_state.title: [T6b][UPDATE] Update reinstall-hooks.sh to register post-commit and prepare-commit-msg hooks
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
Update reinstall-hooks.sh and .pre-commit-config.yaml to install the two new hooks.

## Changes required
### reinstall-hooks.sh
- Add post-commit to the hook loop (currently: pre-commit pre-push prepare-commit-msg)
- Guard post-commit registration with existence check to preserve backward compatibility:
  if [[ -f "$DSO_PLUGIN_DIR/hooks/post-commit-override-cleanup.sh" ]]; then
    pre-commit install --hook-type post-commit
  fi
- prepare-commit-msg is already in the loop; verify it is registered (no-op if already present)

### .pre-commit-config.yaml
- Add post-commit stage entry pointing to post-commit-override-cleanup.sh
- Add prepare-commit-msg stage entry pointing to prepare-commit-msg-override-audit.sh
- COUPLING CONSTRAINT: The .pre-commit-config.yaml stage entries and the reinstall-hooks.sh loop expansion are coupled — committing one without the other leaves hook shims empty. Both changes MUST land in the same commit.

## Classification
UPDATE — no failing test of its own; T6a's test drives the behavior change

## Files to modify
- plugins/dso/scripts/reinstall-hooks.sh (MODIFY)
- .pre-commit-config.yaml (MODIFY)
